g.text: Margin rule (Eichler lab): a read is assigned to its best-scoring alignment only if no other alignment of the read, anywhere in the genome, scores within T alignment-score units (a read

g.text: with no other alignment is assigned); otherwise it is discarded. Rustle leaves reads with MAPQ > 0 at the aligner's primary alignment and applies the copy-assignment test to MAPQ-0
